title: Chapter 73: Provoking A War
content:
Chapter 73: Provoking A War

With the supplies, the Alliance Army, including the Zerg, had a full meal, and all the mounts were well fed.

After a short rest, the Alliance Army began to march out.

Niu Kun came out to see them off, and the Alliance Army's logistics personnel and supplies were left with him.

The Alliance Army left the territory where the Niu Clan was stationed. Although they were all combat troops now, the marching speed was not satisfactory, as if they were taking a walk to digest the food after dinner.

Surrounding the Alliance Army were the surveillance personnel of the Tengu Clan, and every move of the army was under the attention of the Tengu Clan.

Therefore, there were many things that Wu Qing did not plan to use the Zerg troops in the Alliance Army.

The five thousand Zerg puppies that gathered in the Zerg territory last night were on their way. The puppies, who had upgraded their speed twice, would not take too long to run to this area.

The Alliance Army's marching speed was Wu Qing deliberately delaying time.

Wu Qing asked the Tengu guide to follow him, and asked the alliance army to deliberately detour to the place he was interested in, so as to observe the situation in the war zone openly.

He also asked the flag of the Mengjiang Independent Territory Alliance to be displayed, and people held it high and swaggered through the city.

The alliance was destined to become famous in this battle, and now it was necessary to let more people see the style of the alliance army.

In this process, 5,000 puppies had rushed to the area near the base camp of the evil god army. Most of the puppies burrowed underground and lurked, while a few puppies scattered and began to collect various intelligence.

The intelligence collected by these puppies was sorted out by the Queen of Insects and then reported to Wu Qing.

According to the latest intelligence collected by the puppies, it is almost impossible for ordinary armies to cross the blockade of the small forces and scouts of the evil god army and enter the target area of this mission without alerting the enemy.

This situation may be due to the unknown true and false war yesterday, which made the evil god camp strengthen its vigilance, or it may be that the Tengu clan deliberately did not explain the risks of this area.

If the Tengu clan did this on purpose, then their real intention was to let the alliance army take the mission as an inducement, fall into the trap, and fight with the evil god army first.

Unfortunately, they did not expect that their calculations would play into Wu Qing's hands!

Without reliable friendly forces to cooperate, it is a suicide act to go deep into the rear of the enemy's base camp to intercept the food supply.

Wu Qing would not take such a risk easily without full confidence.

As for the battle yesterday, no one told him where it was fought. He did not believe that it was fought behind the enemy's base camp, which made the enemy seem too incompetent.

In fact, every military commander of the evil god camp that Wu Qing met was very professional and would not make such a low-level mistake.

After Wu Qing used the dog's stealth ability to roughly figure out the situation of the garrison outside the evil god army camp, he handed the task of leading the way to the Tengu clan guide and let him play freely.

Everything was back on track. The Tengu guides followed the route that had been planned long ago and led the Alliance Army from the south side of the Evil God Army camp, making a big circle and going around to the back of the enemy.

If they really went around like this, it would be troublesome for the Alliance Army to retreat.

So, when the Alliance Army reached the south of the enemy camp, Wu Qing let the dog responsible for reconnaissance deliberately expose himself and attracted a small group of enemy patrol troops.

The dog on guard outside the Alliance Army suddenly bumped into the enemy patrol troops, and the battle broke out instantly!

"Howl!"

The signal flares of the enemy patrol troops when they encountered the enemy soared into the sky, and the Alliance Army was exposed!

"Deploy the battle formation! Prepare for battle!"

Standing in the elite troops of the Alliance, Meng loudly issued combat orders.

The enemy patrol troops were a team of bear goblin cavalry. A large number of dogs rushed up, not caring about the battle formation at all, and instantly overwhelmed the enemy.

It was the first time for Yu Chong and Bai Yan to see the real battle scene of the Zerg army. They were keenly aware that the Zerg army was more terrifying than the army of the evil god believers.

The Tengu cavalry responsible for following and monitoring the alliance army immediately reported the situation here, and they all retreated to a safe area to watch the battle.

As soon as the war started, the puppies showed their fangs and rushed out in all directions. They took the initiative to attack and killed all the enemy scouts and patrol teams in this area.

"Now it's exposed! The mission can't be completed! What should I do!?"

Seeing this situation, the Tengu guide was anxious, and Wu Qing could feel his inner panic and despair.

"Don't think too much, finish this battle first and then consider other things!"

"You go to the rear to watch the battle!"

Wu Qing comforted him and sent the Tengu guide away.

He turned to Meng, Yu Chong and Bai Yan and said: "My Zerg troops are responsible for the main attack and the rear guard! You cooperate with the Hydralisks for long-range output!"

"In the following battles, you must listen to me!"

"No matter what the situation is, I say retreat! You must retreat immediately!"

"Don't worry about the Zerg troops! I have my own plans!"

When Wu Qing arrived on the battlefield, his momentum changed. What he said was an order. Even a person with a personality like Meng did not dare to question it at this time.

"Don't worry! You have the final say on the battlefield!"

Meng was not displeased at this time. Seeing Wu Qing in this state, he was even more respectful.

Yu Chong and Bai Yan also saw another side of Wu Qing. Wu Qing, the lord of Daxia who usually looked easy-going, showed his leadership temperament of controlling everything at this time.

The two of them had no dissatisfaction with Wu Qing's arrangement, and they also expressed their opinions solemnly.

The Zerg puppies moved quickly, and fierce fighting continued around them. It didn't take long for all the forces of the surrounding evil god army to be wiped out.

The evil god army was also not slow, and the evil god believers stationed in the surrounding area quickly gathered together and surrounded this side.

In addition to the armies of the races such as bear goblins, lizardmen, and long-armed ogres that Wu Qing had seen, these evil god believers' armies also included many local races of evil god believers' armies.

For example, the rat tribe, pig tribe, snake tribe, wolf tribe, etc., and even the evil god believers' army of the Tengu tribe, they are all local races that have been transformed into believers by the evil god.

There are many races, and the types of troops are also strange, but for the Zerg, no matter how you change, I will deal with it with one move.

The Zerg army has never been a passive character. Six or seven armies of evil god believers with a strength of about 5,000 soldiers surrounded them from different directions. The puppies and hydralisks gathered and rushed towards the nearest army of evil god believers.

There were puppies everywhere and hosts in the air. The situation of the entire battlefield was under Wu Qing's control. The headquarters formation composed of the elite troops of the alliance did not need the protection of the Zerg at all. The Zerg just had to kill as much as they wanted.

The lizardmen army, which numbered about 5,000, was the first target chosen by the Zerg. Actual combat has proved that the lizardmen have no power to fight back in front of the Zerg.

Two thousand hydralisks approached and fired several rounds, and tens of thousands of puppies rushed forward. The nearly 5,000 lizardmen army was instantly wiped out by the Zerg.

All the lizardmen disappeared in light, leaving only a mess on the ground.
